finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | Read `retries`, bump renamed it `retryCount` | Read new name, fall back to old |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Threw on `undefined` flag | Treat unset as `false` |

`node build.js` exits 0. The other 8 warnings are `DEP0142`, `DEP0198` and 6 more. They are printed as fixed strings inside `build.js` and name files that do not exist here.

Next: nothing.
